source.title: Scarlet Activities
source.description: While we play nice with the Scarlet Crusaders here, they continue to behave suspiciously elsewhere. Some of my contacts in Tirisfal tell me of a daring Scarlet Crusade incursion into the heart of the Undercity itself, and we've received reports from our scouts of large caravans moving supplies through the plaguelands. A band of elite scarlet forces has been spotted near the Crusader Outpost in Tirisfal Glades, between the Balnir Farmstead and Venomweb Vale. If you would, go and see what you can find there.
source.objective: Travel to the area near the Crusader Outpost northwest of The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades and investigate for signs of recent Scarlet Crusade activity. Bring any information you recover back to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
source.completion:
I see. So it seems the Crusade abducted someone from the city, and someone important, at that. This is most concerning. Thank you, <name>.  For now, do nothing and speak to no one of this. Our alliance with the Scarlet Crusade is tenuous, but we need all the help we can get to deal with the threat of Naxxramas at the moment.

I will follow up on this on my own. I may call upon you in the future for more aid in this. Until then, go with the light.
